scope: Synthetic India-based incorporated suppliers. One primary subcategory; no spend bands or stacked categories.

BASE-001.label: Business registration
BASE-001.accepted_evidence: Business registration certificate or current company registry extract.
BASE-001.required_fields: Legal name; registration number; issuing registry; registration date; status.
checks: The registered legal name matches the portal name under the name rule.
Registration date is on or before the evaluation date and status is Active.

BASE-002.label: Tax registration or accepted tax status
BASE-002.why: Record the supplier tax identity and declared registration status.
BASE-002.accepted_evidence: PAN/tax registration notice; if GST status is not registered, add a signed tax status declaration.
BASE-002.required_fields: Legal name; PAN/tax reference; GST status (registered or not registered); GSTIN when registered; declaration date and signatory when not registered.
checks: The tax legal name matches BASE-001 and the PAN/tax reference matches the portal entry.
A registered supplier supplies a GSTIN; a supplier marked not registered supplies a declaration signed within 180 calendar days.

BASE-003.label: Bank account verification
BASE-003.why: Confirm the account nominated for payment.
BASE-003.accepted_evidence: Bank-issued account letter or bank statement dated within 90 calendar days.
BASE-003.required_fields: Beneficiary legal name; bank name; full account number; IFSC; document date.
checks: The beneficiary name matches BASE-001 and the account number and IFSC exactly match the portal payment fields.
The document date is no more than 90 calendar days before the evaluation date.

CONF-001.label: Confidentiality undertaking
CONF-001.why: Set confidentiality duties for work involving company information.
CONF-001.accepted_evidence: Buyer standard confidentiality undertaking signed by both parties.
CONF-001.required_fields: Supplier legal name; buyer name; signatory names; both signatures; execution date.
checks: The supplier name matches BASE-001 and both parties have signed.
The execution date is on or before the evaluation date and within the previous 365 calendar days.

SEC-001.label: Information security assessment
SEC-001.why: Establish minimum controls for technology or sensitive-data services.
SEC-001.accepted_evidence: Buyer security questionnaire, signed within 180 calendar days.
SEC-001.required_fields: Supplier legal name; service scope; security contact; privileged-account MFA; encryption at rest; encryption in transit; incident notice commitment; signature and date.
checks: All three control answers (MFA and both encryption measures) are Yes.
The committed incident notice interval is at most 48 hours and the signed date is within 180 calendar days.

PRIV-001.label: Personal data handling assessment
PRIV-001.why: Make personal-data use and deletion commitments explicit.
PRIV-001.accepted_evidence: Buyer privacy questionnaire, signed within 180 calendar days.
PRIV-001.required_fields: Supplier legal name; whether personal data is processed; purpose; data categories; processing locations; subprocessors; retention after service end; deletion interval; signature and date.
checks: Every field is answered; “None” is allowed for categories and subprocessors, and “Not applicable” is allowed for locations, retention and deletion only when the supplier states it processes no personal data.
If personal data is processed, retention after service end is at most 24 months and deletion on buyer request is within 30 calendar days.

CONT-001.label: Service continuity
CONT-001.why: Demonstrate a practical service recovery plan.
CONT-001.accepted_evidence: Signed continuity and recovery summary reviewed within 180 calendar days.
CONT-001.required_fields: Supplier legal name; covered service; recovery owner; recovery time objective (RTO); recovery point objective (RPO); last exercise date; review date.
checks: RTO is at most 72 hours and RPO is at most 24 hours.
The last exercise is within 365 calendar days and the plan review is within 180 calendar days.

INS-CYB-001.label: Cyber liability coverage
INS-CYB-001.why: Provide cover for a cyber incident involving the contracted service.
INS-CYB-001.required_fields: Policyholder legal name; insurer; policy number; cyber coverage amount in INR; effective date; expiry date.
checks: The policyholder matches BASE-001, the cover explicitly includes cyber liability and coverage is at least ₹5 crore.
The policy is effective on the evaluation date and expires at least 30 calendar days later.

INS-PI-001.label: Professional indemnity coverage
INS-PI-001.why: Provide cover for errors in professional services.
INS-PI-001.required_fields: Policyholder legal name; insurer; policy number; professional indemnity amount in INR; effective date; expiry date.
checks: The policyholder matches BASE-001, the cover names professional indemnity and coverage is at least ₹1 crore.
The policy is effective on the evaluation date and expires at least 30 calendar days later.

CRED-001.label: Professional or service authorization
CRED-001.why: Show authorization relevant to the contracted specialist service.
CRED-001.accepted_evidence: Relevant provider credential, professional registration or service authorization.
CRED-001.required_fields: Supplier or named responsible professional; issuer; credential number; authorized service scope; issue date; expiry date.
checks: The authorization scope covers the selected service and the named entity or professional is linked to this supplier.
The issue date is on or before evaluation and the expiry is at least 30 calendar days later.

PEOP-001.label: Workforce compliance
PEOP-001.why: Confirm that supplier-provided workers have accountable employment controls.
PEOP-001.accepted_evidence: Signed workforce compliance declaration dated within 180 calendar days.
PEOP-001.required_fields: Supplier legal name; worker engagement model; worker records maintained; wage and contract compliance attestation; workforce contact; signature and date.
checks: Both the worker-record and wage/contract compliance attestations are Yes.
A workforce contact is supplied and the declaration is signed within 180 calendar days.

PEOP-002.label: Worker screening
PEOP-002.why: Ensure assigned workers are screened before receiving access.
PEOP-002.accepted_evidence: Signed worker screening process declaration dated within 180 calendar days.
PEOP-002.required_fields: Supplier legal name; identity check; consent procedure; background check; coverage of assigned workers; access timing; signature and date.
checks: Identity, consent and background checks are each attested Yes for 100% of assigned workers.
The declaration commits to complete the checks before a worker receives access.

SITE-001.label: On site safety
SITE-001.why: Control safety risks in work performed on site.
SITE-001.accepted_evidence: Signed site safety plan or method statement reviewed within 180 calendar days.
SITE-001.required_fields: Supplier legal name; service scope; hazards; control measures; emergency lead; PPE commitment; incident notice interval; review date.
checks: The plan lists hazards, controls and an emergency lead, and PPE is committed where the plan identifies a PPE need.
Incident notice is within 24 hours and the plan review is within 180 calendar days.

SITE-002.label: Physical security authorization
SITE-002.why: Show authority to provide physical guarding and control site access.
SITE-002.accepted_evidence: Physical guarding authorization and supplier guard-training declaration.
SITE-002.required_fields: Supplier legal name; issuer; authorization number; guarding scope; effective and expiry dates; trained-guard attestation; declaration date.
checks: The authorization scope includes physical guarding and the supplier attests that assigned guards are trained.
Authorization is effective and has at least 30 calendar days remaining; the declaration is within 180 calendar days.

FOOD-001.label: Food supply controls
FOOD-001.why: Maintain basic control and traceability of supplied food products.
FOOD-001.accepted_evidence: Signed food sourcing and handling declaration dated within 180 calendar days.
FOOD-001.required_fields: Supplier legal name; product types; source and batch traceability; storage method; recall contact; recall notice interval; signature and date.
checks: Source/batch traceability and documented storage methods are affirmed.
A recall contact is named and the commitment to notify the buyer is within 24 hours.

FOOD-002.label: Prepared meal controls
FOOD-002.why: Add hygiene controls for preparing or serving meals.
FOOD-002.accepted_evidence: Food hygiene certificate for the service site and signed food safety plan.
FOOD-002.required_fields: Supplier legal name; site; certificate issuer, number and expiry; allergen controls; temperature controls; food-handler training date; plan review date.
checks: The certificate identifies the service site and has at least 30 calendar days remaining; both allergen and temperature controls are documented.
Handler training took place within 365 calendar days and the safety plan was reviewed within 180 calendar days.

EVENT-001.label: Event operations
EVENT-001.why: Establish how events are delivered safely.
EVENT-001.accepted_evidence: Signed generic event safety and delivery plan reviewed within 180 calendar days.
EVENT-001.required_fields: Supplier legal name; typical event scope; maximum planned attendance; evacuation arrangements; first-aid lead; incident notice interval; review date.
checks: The plan includes maximum attendance, evacuation arrangements and a first-aid lead.
Incident notification is within 24 hours and the review date is within 180 calendar days.

TRANS-001.label: Transport and cargo protection
TRANS-001.why: Protect goods in the supplier’s custody during transport.
TRANS-001.accepted_evidence: Cargo/transit insurance certificate and signed custody-control declaration.
TRANS-001.required_fields: Supplier legal name; insurer; policy number; cargo cover in INR; policy effective and expiry dates; tracking method; custody owner; loss notice interval; declaration date.
checks: Cover applies to goods in transit and is at least ₹50 lakh; a tracking method and custody owner are identified.
The policy is effective with at least 30 calendar days remaining; loss notification is within 24 hours and the declaration is within 180 calendar days.

STORE-001.label: Warehouse controls
STORE-001.why: Account for inventory held at supplier facilities.
STORE-001.accepted_evidence: Signed warehouse site and inventory-control summary reviewed within 180 calendar days.
STORE-001.required_fields: Supplier legal name; warehouse location; access logging; inventory reconciliation interval; loss escalation interval; control owner; review date.
checks: Access is logged and inventory reconciliation occurs at least every 30 calendar days.
Loss is escalated within 24 hours, a control owner is named and the summary is reviewed within 180 calendar days.

PROD-001.label: Equipment conformity and warranty
PROD-001.why: Record supplied equipment specifications, conformity and support.
PROD-001.accepted_evidence: Manufacturer specification/conformity sheet and supplier warranty statement.
PROD-001.required_fields: Supplier legal name; manufacturer; model or SKU; conformity statement; warranty duration; warranty start event; support contact.
checks: The model/SKU in the evidence matches the model/SKU offered; a manufacturer conformity statement is present.
Warranty is at least 12 months starting at delivery and a support contact is named.

PAY-001.label: Payment service controls
PAY-001.accepted_evidence: Signed payment controls declaration dated within 180 calendar days.
PAY-001.required_fields: Supplier legal name; transaction scope; dual authorization; reconciliation frequency; dispute contact; dispute escalation interval; signature and date.
checks: Dual authorization is Yes and transactions are reconciled at least daily.
A dispute contact is named and escalation is committed within 48 hours.

TRAIN-001.label: Training provider qualifications
TRAIN-001.why: Establish that the trainers can deliver the contracted instruction.
TRAIN-001.accepted_evidence: Provider qualification pack with trainer roster, course outline, and trainer credential or experience record.
TRAIN-001.required_fields: Supplier legal name; trainer names; course topics; credential number/issuer/expiry or dated experience history; provider contact.
checks: Each named lead trainer has a current topic-relevant credential OR a dated record of at least 24 months of relevant delivery experience.
The course outline covers the contracted training topics and a provider contact is named.

subcategories.label: SaaS and Cloud Software
subcategories.definition: Hosted business applications supplied for the company to use.
subcategories.examples: HR, CRM, expense, collaboration, or project management software.
subcategories.boundary: Security tools whose primary function is to protect or test systems belong in TECH-CYB. Infrastructure operated on the company’s behalf belongs in TECH-ITM.

subcategories.label: Cybersecurity
subcategories.definition: Products or services primarily used to protect, monitor, assess, or control information systems.
subcategories.examples: Antivirus and endpoint protection, SOC services, penetration testing, vulnerability management, and identity or access management.
subcategories.boundary: General cloud business software belongs in TECH-SW. Selling network hardware without an operating service belongs in GOODS-ITE.

subcategories.label: Managed IT and Infrastructure Services
subcategories.definition: Ongoing management, support, or operation of company systems, devices, networks, or infrastructure.
subcategories.examples: Managed networks, cloud infrastructure support, IT help desks, and managed workplace services.
subcategories.boundary: A one-time sale of laptops or networking equipment belongs in GOODS-ITE. A standalone security monitoring service belongs in TECH-CYB.

subcategories.label: Business and Technical Consulting
subcategories.definition: Advisory or implementation work on strategy, operations, technology, or engineering.
subcategories.examples: Management consulting, engineering advisory, strategy, and technical implementation consulting.
subcategories.boundary: Ongoing operation of company IT belongs in TECH-ITM. Legal, tax, accounting, or audit work belongs in PROF-LFA.

subcategories.label: Legal Finance and Audit
subcategories.definition: Regulated or specialist advice concerning law, tax, accounting, audit, or corporate finance.
subcategories.examples: Law firms, tax advisers, auditors, accounting firms, and financial advisers.
subcategories.boundary: A supplier processing company payments as a service belongs in SENS-PAY; an insurance broker belongs in SENS-INS.

subcategories.label: Marketing Creative and Research
subcategories.definition: Creative, communications, advertising, or market insight services.
subcategories.examples: Advertising agencies, graphic design, branding, content production, and market research.
subcategories.boundary: A provider whose primary deliverable is an event or venue belongs in FOOD-EVT. A general-purpose marketing software subscription belongs in TECH-SW.

subcategories.label: Recruitment
subcategories.definition: Finding and presenting candidates for roles filled directly by the company.
subcategories.examples: Recruitment agencies, candidate sourcing, and executive search.
subcategories.boundary: Supplying workers employed or engaged by the supplier to perform company work belongs in WORK-STA.

subcategories.label: Temporary and Contract Staffing
subcategories.definition: Supplying personnel who perform work for the company under a staffing or contingent workforce arrangement.
subcategories.examples: Temporary workers, outsourced personnel, and contract resources.
subcategories.boundary: Candidate search alone belongs in WORK-REC. A specialist consulting firm delivering a defined advisory output belongs in PROF-CONS.

subcategories.label: Training and Learning
subcategories.definition: Delivering training, workshops, qualifications, or learning services.
subcategories.examples: Corporate trainers, certification providers, workshops, and learning services.
subcategories.boundary: A standalone learning software subscription belongs in TECH-SW when software is the contracted deliverable.

subcategories.label: Cleaning Housekeeping and Maintenance
subcategories.definition: Routine cleaning, upkeep, and maintenance of premises or installed facilities.
subcategories.examples: Office cleaning, housekeeping, HVAC servicing, plumbing, and routine electrical maintenance.
subcategories.boundary: Major construction or fit-out work belongs in FAC-CON. Guarding and site security belong in FAC-SEC.

subcategories.label: Physical Security
subcategories.definition: Personnel or services whose primary purpose is to protect premises and control physical access.
subcategories.examples: Security guards, reception security, access control personnel, and site patrols.
subcategories.boundary: Cybersecurity monitoring belongs in TECH-CYB. Installation of security equipment as a goods purchase may belong in GOODS-ITE or GOODS-IND, according to the main deliverable.

subcategories.label: Construction Fit Out and Repair
subcategories.definition: Project-based construction, renovation, fit-out, or substantial repair at company premises.
subcategories.examples: Office fit-outs, civil work, major electrical installations, and renovation contractors.
subcategories.boundary: Routine maintenance belongs in FAC-MNT. Supply of building materials without construction services belongs in GOODS-IND.

subcategories.label: Pantry Coffee and Packaged Consumables
subcategories.definition: Supply of packaged food, drinks, and pantry items without operating a meal service.
subcategories.examples: Coffee beans, tea, packaged snacks, beverages, and pantry stock.
subcategories.boundary: Preparing or serving meals for the company belongs in FOOD-CAT. General office stationery belongs in GOODS-OFF.

subcategories.label: Catering and Meal Services
subcategories.definition: Preparation, delivery, or operation of prepared meals or food service.
subcategories.examples: Corporate catering, cafeteria operation, and prepared meal supply.
subcategories.boundary: Sealed coffee or snack supply without meal preparation belongs in FOOD-PAN. Event planning with food as one component belongs in FOOD-EVT when the event is the main contract.

subcategories.label: Events and Hospitality
subcategories.definition: Planning or providing events, venues, conferences, or hospitality services.
subcategories.examples: Conference organisers, event management, venue services, and corporate hospitality.
subcategories.boundary: A contract solely to prepare and serve meals belongs in FOOD-CAT. Creative campaign work without event delivery belongs in PROF-MKT.

subcategories.label: Courier and Last Mile Delivery
subcategories.definition: Local parcel, document, or final-mile delivery services.
subcategories.examples: Document couriers, parcel delivery, and local delivery networks.
subcategories.boundary: Freight haulage as the main service belongs in LOG-FRT. Storage and fulfilment belong in LOG-WH.

subcategories.label: Freight and Transportation
subcategories.definition: Commercial movement of goods over longer routes or with freight operations.
subcategories.examples: Trucking, freight movement, and interstate transportation.
subcategories.boundary: Local parcel delivery belongs in LOG-COU. Managed inventory storage belongs in LOG-WH.

subcategories.label: Warehousing and Third Party Logistics
subcategories.definition: Storage, fulfilment, or managed inventory handling for company goods.
subcategories.examples: Warehouses, fulfilment providers, and third party logistics operators.
subcategories.boundary: Transport only belongs in LOG-FRT or LOG-COU according to the service. Supplying warehouse equipment alone belongs in GOODS-IND.

subcategories.label: Office and General Supplies
subcategories.definition: Routine office products and general nontechnical supplies.
subcategories.examples: Stationery, office furniture, printing supplies, and general consumables.
subcategories.boundary: Food and pantry consumables belong in FOOD-PAN. IT hardware belongs in GOODS-ITE.

subcategories.label: IT AV and Electronic Equipment
subcategories.definition: Physical computing, audiovisual, networking, or other electronic equipment.
subcategories.examples: Laptops, monitors, conferencing equipment, and network hardware.
subcategories.boundary: Managed operation of the equipment belongs in TECH-ITM when it is the main service. Cybersecurity products supplied as a security solution belong in TECH-CYB.

subcategories.label: Industrial Electrical and Safety Equipment
subcategories.definition: Industrial, electrical, mechanical, or personal safety products supplied as goods.
subcategories.examples: Machinery, electrical components, PPE, and industrial tools.
subcategories.boundary: Installation or construction as the main deliverable belongs in FAC-CON. Routine maintenance services belong in FAC-MNT.

subcategories.label: Payments Banking and Fintech
subcategories.definition: Processing payments or providing banking, payment, or financial transaction services.
subcategories.examples: Payment gateways, payment processors, banking services, and corporate card providers.
subcategories.boundary: Financial advice without payment processing belongs in PROF-LFA. A generic expense software subscription belongs in TECH-SW.

subcategories.label: Insurance and Brokerage
subcategories.definition: Providing insurance coverage or arranging and brokering insurance products.
subcategories.examples: Insurers, insurance brokers, and risk placement intermediaries.
subcategories.boundary: Legal or financial advice without an insurance product belongs in PROF-LFA.

subcategories.label: Data Processing BPO and Identity Services
subcategories.definition: Operating processes on behalf of the company that handle employee, customer, or identity information.
subcategories.examples: Payroll processing, background verification, identity verification, customer support outsourcing, and document processing.
subcategories.boundary: Selling a generic software tool without operating the data process belongs in TECH-SW. Supplying contract workers to perform work belongs in WORK-STA.
